# Mehdi Forkani — Freelance Web & Mobile App Developer, Casablanca & Worldwide

> Mehdi Forkani is a freelance web and mobile app developer based in Casablanca, Morocco,
> working remotely with clients worldwide. He designs and builds secure, production web
> platforms and mobile apps using Laravel, React, Inertia.js, and React Native for startups,
> NGOs, institutions, and organizations in Morocco, Europe, Africa, the Middle East,
> North America and beyond. He is Head Coach of the LionsGeek Coding School and Project
> Manager at LionsGeek PRO.

## About
- Name: Mehdi Forkani (also written Forkani Mehdi, forkanimahdi, مهدي الفرقاني)
- Role: Freelance Web & Mobile App Developer (Full-Stack)
- Location: Casablanca, Morocco (Moroccan time), working remotely worldwide
- Languages: Arabic (Darija), French, English
- Core stack: Laravel, Inertia.js, React, React Native, Expo, JavaScript, PHP, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, REST APIs
- Available for: freelance and contract web and mobile app development, remote, for clients anywhere in the world
- Recognition: Jury's Coup de Cœur, AVATARS 2026 ([IN]VISIBLE Festival, KBR, Brussels)
- [Full story and FAQ](https://forkanimahdi.com/about)

## Journey
1. Started as a commercial assistant at Banque Populaire and an administrative assistant at the CNSS.
2. Joined the very first cohort of the LionsGeek Coding School in Casablanca.
3. Became a full-stack developer at LionsGeek, shipping web platforms, dashboards and mobile apps.
4. Became Head Coach of the LionsGeek Coding School, guiding each cohort to full platforms in a few months.
5. Project Manager at LionsGeek PRO: led Casatourat (Casamémoire), YES Africa (Jadara Foundation) and My LionsGeek.
6. 2026: led the team behind ADA, a conversational metahuman of Ada Lovelace, winner of the Jury's Coup de Cœur at AVATARS 2026 in Brussels.
7. Today: freelance web and mobile app developer, from Casablanca to clients all over the world.

## Services
- Mobile app development (React Native, iOS & Android)
- Web application and SaaS development (Laravel, React, Inertia.js)
- Admin dashboards, internal tools, and management platforms
- E-commerce and booking platforms
- REST API and backend development
- Full-stack product delivery and project management, from the first draft to the final delivery

## Frequently asked questions
- Is Mehdi Forkani available as a freelance web and mobile app developer? Yes. He is based in Casablanca, Morocco, and takes on freelance web and mobile app projects for startups, small businesses, NGOs and institutions worldwide: in Morocco, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, North America and beyond.
- Does he work with clients outside Morocco? Yes, remotely, all over the world, with async collaboration, regular demos and clear written updates. Morocco's time zone overlaps well with Europe, Africa, the Middle East and the US East Coast.
- What does he build? Web platforms and SaaS products, admin dashboards and internal tools, e-commerce sites, booking and management platforms, and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android, with their back-ends and REST APIs.
- How does he work? He starts by understanding how the client really works, designs the product, builds it in clear reviewable steps, launches it and keeps supporting it. Security is built in from day one.
- Does he work in French? Oui : développeur web et mobile freelance basé à Casablanca, il crée des applications web et mobiles sur mesure pour les entreprises, les startups et les associations au Maroc et partout dans le monde.
- How to hire him? Use the [contact page](https://forkanimahdi.com/contact), email forkanimahdi@gmail.com, or LinkedIn.
